sp25_mt3_E3.1.title: E3.1 - Special QR Decomposition in 2D
sp25_mt3_E3.1.description: Derives QR decomposition for 2×2 matrix with special structure, using geometric insight about orthogonal vectors in 2D.
concepts: Finding orthogonal vectors by flipping and negating components
key_formulas: Orthogonal vector to [α, β]ᵀ is [-β, α]ᵀ or [β, -α]ᵀ

sp25_mt3_E3.2.title: E3.2 - Linear Regression
sp25_mt3_E3.2.description: Linear regression through mean-centered data in 2D, finding best-fit line through origin using least squares.

sp25_mt3_E3.3.title: E3.3 - The Golden State Space
sp25_mt3_E3.3.description: State-space system generating Fibonacci sequence, with eigenanalysis using golden ratio φ = (1+√5)/2.
key_formulas: Properties: φφ̂ = -1, φ + φ̂ = 1, φ - φ̂ = √5

sp25_mt3_E3.4.title: E3.4 - Basic SVD
sp25_mt3_E3.4.description: Compute compact SVD of 3×2 matrix: A = UΣVᵀ.
concepts: Eigenvalues of AᵀA give singular values: σᵢ = √λᵢ
Right singular vectors: eigenvectors of AᵀA
Left singular vectors: eigenvectors of AAᵀ
Compact SVD: keep only non-zero singular values
key_formulas: U from Avᵢ/σᵢ or eigenvectors of AAᵀ (3×2 for compact)

sp25_mt3_E3.5.title: E3.5 - Using PCA to Analyze Bacteria
sp25_mt3_E3.5.description: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on gene-expression data to classify bacteria species.
concepts: Singular value decay indicates number of components needed

analysis_results.interpretation: Only 2 PCs needed → 2 distinct bacteria types

key_formulas: Mean-centering: A = X - μ1ᵀ where μ = (1/n)Σxₖ
PC projection: z = Uₖᵀa where Uₖ = first k columns of U
Number of clusters = number of distinct groups in PC space
